Using ChatGPT Plus for long tasks? Give your agent a sense of time with QuotaGuard.
Ten percent left means something different when reset is two hours away, or just fifteen minutes away.
QuotaGuard divides remaining quota by hours until reset. That gives five, or forty, percentage points per hour.
A twelve point reference guides four pacing levels: tight, conservative, comfortable, and abundant.
Keep weekly limits in view. Preserve essential checks. Save a concrete next step. No extra quota is promised.
Install the skill, then ask QuotaGuard to check your budget and plan the work. Open source. Built for Plus.
